task: We want to add 20 charging points by 1 March 2027. Using the observed usage data, which existing sites/areas show the highest saturation and are the best candidates? Give a ranked shortlist with the data behind it.
markdown:
## Answer
The strongest candidates are in Bolzano: BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01, BZ_BOEHLER_01, BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02, BZ_PIAVE_01 and BZ_P_VITTORIA. They combine high occupancy and high full-time saturation with at least about 100 h of observable exposure [E2, E3]. All figures rest on a small share of the 56-day window, so the ranking is indicative only [E2, E3].

## Key findings
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (2 points) ranks 1st by occupancy at 66.9% and 2nd by full_time at 46.2%, with 203 observed starts and 197.89 h exposure [E2, E3].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 (1 point) ranks 1st by full_time at 57.0%; occupancy is the same because it has one point. It has 170 observed starts and the highest exposure among the top sites, 305.59 h [E3].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 (2 points) has occupancy 51.9%, full_time 30.1% and the most observed starts among the top 10, 261, with 223.8 h exposure [E2].
- BZ_PIAVE_01 (2 points) has occupancy 50.8%, full_time 29.9%, 212 observed starts and 214.48 h exposure; its peak hour is 23:00 [E2].
- BZ_P_VITTORIA (3 points) has occupancy 63.5% and full_time 27.7%, with 135 observed starts but only 110.55 h exposure (coverage 8.2%) [E2, E3].
- BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 (occupancy 56.1%, 53 starts, 59.46 h), BZ_RESSEL_01 (52.2%, 46 starts, 44.44 h) and PALAONDA_03 (47.5%, 27 starts, 34.94 h) look saturated but have thin evidence, so they are excluded from the shortlist [E2, E3].
- Peak hours for the top sites are mostly 08:00 or 09:00, with BZ_BOEHLER_01 at 05:00 [E2, E3].

## Recommendation
Prioritise the five shortlisted sites in this order: 1) BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01, 2) BZ_BOEHLER_01, 3) BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02, 4) BZ_PIAVE_01, 5) BZ_P_VITTORIA [E2, E3]. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 and BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 share a name stem and may be the same area, which would favour a combined expansion there; this is inferred from names, not confirmed by coordinates [E2]. Before committing the 20 points, verify the thinly observed sites (BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01, BZ_RESSEL_01, PALAONDA_03) with more data, and check data quality and hourly profiles for the shortlist.

## Limitations & unknowns
- Observations are status only, not energy, official sessions or demand [E1].
- Coverage is low everywhere, from 2.6% to 22.7% of the window, so figures may not represent all 56 days [E2, E3].
- 22 sites were excluded for having under 24 h of exposure, so their saturation is unknown [E2, E3].
- The data cannot show how many points to add per site or why a site is busy. Stale flags, gap counts, data_quality and hourly_profile were not checked.
- The analysis covers only the Bolzano bounding box, not the whole province [E1].

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=full_time) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14

review_note:
- **Main caveat:** Coverage is only 2.6–22.7% of the 56-day window and reflects status data, not energy or demand. The ranking is indicative, so don't commit the 20 points on it alone.
- The shortlist leans on 100+ h exposure, but BZ_P_VITTORIA has just 110.55 h (8.2% coverage) and BZ_BOEHLER_01 rests on a single point.
- Citation check shows all 49 numbers traced, with none untraced or unsupported.
